purpose: Prevent post-result escalation of the realized-realm audit into the manuscript title, abstract, or main conclusions.

not_evaluable.manuscript_use: Do not make a realized-realm generality claim. Report the audit as NOT_EVALUABLE in supplement/provenance only.

condition: pooled within-realm effective-contributor association is positive
pooled within-realm maximum-single-host-share association is negative
descriptive_main_text.manuscript_use: May report realized-realm stratification descriptively in Results/Discussion, explicitly as post-hoc generality audit. Do not state robust replication in abstract.

condition: two-sided within-realm permutation p < 0.05 for both architecture responses
butterfly-family-stratified permutation retains the expected sign for both responses
leave-one-interpretable-realm-out pooled associations retain the expected sign for both responses
primary-realm-share >= 0.60 sensitivity retains the expected sign for both responses
1-degree-cell-weighted realm sensitivity retains the expected sign for both responses
robust_main_text.manuscript_use: May state that the portfolio architecture is robust to realized zoogeographic context in the main Results and Discussion.

condition: family-stratified permutation p < 0.05 for at least one architecture response and <= 0.10 for the other
stratified bootstrap 95% interval for architecture-minus-magnitude association is entirely above zero for effective contributors
stratified bootstrap 95% interval for dominance-oriented architecture-minus-magnitude association is entirely above zero
abstract_eligible.manuscript_use: A concise realized-realm robustness clause may enter the abstract. The title remains centered on butterfly specialization/resource portfolios rather than naming realms.

magnitude_boundary.reason: The global magnitude association was not established as statistically equivalent to zero; realm analysis is a generality/contrast audit, not a retrospective equivalence rescue.
magnitude_boundary.allowed: Describe the magnitude association and compare its strength with architecture using the predeclared stratified bootstrap contrast.
magnitude_boundary.forbidden: Claim realm-wise independence or equivalence to zero unless a separately prospective equivalence design is conducted.

claim_boundary: The realm audit is post-hoc with respect to the already observed resource-portfolio result.
Promotion criteria are fixed before opening the recovered realm result.
Failure of promotion criteria does not authorize threshold changes, species replacement, realm regrouping, or alternative sampling-weight selection.
